messages:
oliver: quick mock posted: mini-toggle on perf badge (catalog vs pinned). figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique
maya: i prefer pinned-by-default when a user pins a version. less surprising.
jas: implementation concern: per-row toggles hurt virtualization. suggest session-level override stored on the compare route.
lucy_a11y: a11y: ensure aria-labels like 'P95 latency for Model X (pinned v3.1)  110 milliseconds' and focusable control with visible ring.
maya: microcopy: visual stays 'p95:110ms' but aria-label verbose. also keep hint text <100 chars.
dev-bot: snapshot: https://ci.internal/snap/9001  diffs: badge color, focus ring.
oliver: proposal: default to catalog metrics, show inline hint when user pins single row offering 'Show pinned metrics'. toggle persists session-only. multi-pin -> modal compare (always pinned metrics).
jas: fine. dev estimate 2 days plus a11y review.
lucy_a11y: +1 with aria-live polite on updates.
oliver: thanks all  i'll update figma and post checklist here.
